title: Chain the Builder
goal: Implement consuming builder methods that allow fluid method chaining.
hints: Method chaining requires returning ownership of the updated builder.
The method must take `mut self` by value and return `Self`.
explanation: Consuming builder methods take `mut self` by value, modify fields in place, and return `self` as `Self`. This passes owned builders down the call chain into `.build()`. Taking `&self` fails with `E0594` because immutable references cannot mutate fields. Returning `()` breaks the pipeline with `E0599` because `()` lacks a `.build()` method.
